answer: An farming party running 15 aliases thus needs 189 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in orchard, expire in trellis, and opal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4014 identities would post 3957 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
